verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships its own SaaS AI product (Visalaw AI, including a Research Agent), so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server or MCP endpoint, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec (all 404). Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
